_how: Every pose your character can strike. Try one in the game with /charanim <name>, or /charanim <name> <tick> to hold it at one moment. Copy this file to config/charpowers/player_poses.json and change it there: /charanim reload picks it up without a restart. t = time in ticks (20 a second). spine = lean forward, twist right, lean left. head = added to where you look: down, right, tilt left. ra/la = right and left arm: raise forward is negative x, -90 points straight ahead, -180 straight up; y swings it right; z tips it out (out is + on the right arm, - on the left). rl/ll = legs, the same way. root = the whole body tips. lift = the whole body moves: left, down, back in model pixels. All angles in degrees. ease shapes the move from this keyframe to the next: LINEAR SINE IN OUT IN3 OUT3 BACK ANTICIPATE SETTLE HOLD. in/out = ticks of fading in and out. follow = how much the chest and arms turn with your look (0 to 1). firstPerson = false: nothing changes in first person. stopOnMove, stopOnHit = end early. items = false: your held item isn't drawn in first person. loop = keep going round between these two ticks until the ticks are up. prop = something in the hands: book.
